Method of Attack: Phishing email impersonating Spamhaus Project to trick recipients into downloading a password-protected zip file containing an obfuscated Visual Basic Script (VBS) file
Execution of the VBS file creates and launches Ursnif malware executables that steal data such as keystrokes, clipboard contents, browsing history, and running programs
Attack Vector: Phishing email with Google Drive link to malicious password-protected zip file
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing email claiming email address added to Spamhaus Block List (SBL)
